trap.label: pleased
trap.wrong: We are pleasured to confirm your appointment.
trap.right: We are pleased to confirm your appointment.
trap.why: Em português “temos o prazer” leva o aluno a pleasure/pleasured. Em inglês, o adjetivo é pleased (to) ou a locução it is our pleasure.

fix.right: The arrangement is subject to a review.

fix.right: Remote work is approved for three months.
